status: completed; all-box rational interval prototype, not Lean-checked

plan.errors: zero in both phases for both controllers
plan.refinement: none; no adaptive selection or post-result refinement
plan.pass_rule: terminal energy upper<=12 AND every prefix position enclosure lies in [-2,2]
plan.failure_rule: an enclosure failed; no claim of an unsafe trajectory or impossibility
plan.comparison: same box, rate interval, .05 hold grid, 25 steps, and interval arithmetic. Backup holds -1 throughout; direct samples clip(-x-3v-2a). Backup split into 25 identical-command segments for equal propagation structure.

trust_boundary: Exact rational decision arithmetic in Python. Taylor monotonicity, interval arithmetic, convex quadratic maximization, and path reasoning are not checked by Lean here. No formal replay or physical validation.
cost_boundary: Reported costs are Python interval generation only; not proof elaboration/kernel checking and not controller runtime.
interpretation: Bounds measure certificate conservatism as well as trajectories. Different bounds do not establish control performance superiority. A failure does not establish a violation.
